ex.en: Under the teacher's guidance, I took big strides with my studies.
ex.zh: 在老師的指導下，我的課業進步很多。

ex.en: This type of exercise can be practiced alone and does not require a coach's guidance.
ex.zh: 這類運動可以獨自練習，不需要教練指導。

ex.en: Thank you for your guidance on this project.
ex.zh: 謝謝你在這個專案上的指導。

ex.en: There was some chewing gum on the sole of Tom's shoe.
ex.zh: 湯姆的鞋底黏到了口香糖。

ex.en: Chewing gum is not allowed in class.
ex.zh: 上課時不准嚼口香糖。

ex.en: Do your gums bleed?
ex.zh: 你的牙齦會流血嗎？

ex.en: My gums are bleeding.
ex.zh: 我的牙齦在流血。

ex.en: Can you have a look at my gums?
ex.zh: 可以幫我看一下牙齦嗎？

ex.en: Our troops were constantly attacked by the guerrillas.
ex.zh: 我們的部隊不斷遭到游擊隊攻擊。

ex.en: The guerrillas hid in the mountains.
ex.zh: 游擊隊躲在山裡。

ex.en: The startup used guerrilla marketing to attract attention.
ex.zh: 這家新創公司用游擊式行銷吸引注意。

ex.en: Guerrilla marketing works well on a small budget.
ex.zh: 預算少的時候，游擊式行銷很有效。

ex.en: The guy swimming in the river is my friend.
ex.zh: 在河裡游泳的那個人是我朋友。

ex.en: Do you think of me as a cool guy?
ex.zh: 你覺得我是個很酷的人嗎？

ex.en: He won't be easily discouraged, because he's a tough guy.
ex.zh: 他是個硬漢，不會輕易灰心。

ex.en: He is my friend. Do you guys know him?
ex.zh: 他是我的朋友，你們認識他嗎？

ex.en: I want you guys to do me a favor.
ex.zh: 我想請你們幫我個忙。

ex.en: You very nearly guessed it.
ex.zh: 你差一點就猜對了。

ex.en: Tomiko guessed my weight correctly.
ex.zh: 富子猜中了我的體重。

ex.en: Can you guess how old she is?
ex.zh: 你猜得出她幾歲嗎？

ex.en: I guess you heard about what happened this morning.
ex.zh: 我想你應該聽說今天早上發生的事了。

ex.en: I guess I'll take the bus today.
ex.zh: 我想我今天搭公車好了。

ex.en: My guess is that it will be fine tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我猜明天會是好天氣。

ex.en: Take a guess!
ex.zh: 猜猜看！

ex.en: They heard a gun go off in the distance.
ex.zh: 他們聽到遠處傳來槍聲。

ex.en: Tom said he keeps a gun in his home.
ex.zh: 湯姆說他家裡有一把槍。

ex.en: The policeman aimed his gun at the man.
ex.zh: 警察把槍瞄準那個男人。

ex.en: I guarantee that this information is correct.
ex.zh: 我保證這些資訊是正確的。

ex.en: I can't guarantee that that's going to happen.
ex.zh: 我不能保證那一定會發生。

ex.en: They guarantee this clock can be used for a year.
ex.zh: 他們保證這個時鐘可以用一年。

ex.en: The TV comes with a two-year guarantee.
ex.zh: 這台電視有兩年保固。

ex.en: There's no guarantee that the plan will work.
ex.zh: 不能保證這個計畫一定會成功。

ex.en: The security guard checked my ID.
ex.zh: 警衛檢查了我的證件。

ex.en: There are two guards at the gate.
ex.zh: 大門口有兩名警衛。

ex.en: The soldiers were guarding the bridge.
ex.zh: 士兵們守衛著這座橋。

ex.en: The palace was heavily guarded.
ex.zh: 皇宮戒備森嚴。

ex.en: Be on your guard. He's not an easy one to fool.
ex.zh: 要提防，他不是那麼容易被騙的。

ex.en: Be on your guard against online scams.
ex.zh: 要提防網路詐騙。

ex.en: She declared that she was not guilty.
ex.zh: 她聲稱自己無罪。

ex.en: Nobody can deny that the prisoner is guilty.
ex.zh: 沒有人能否認那名犯人有罪。

ex.en: I feel guilty about missing her birthday.
ex.zh: 錯過她的生日讓我很內疚。

ex.en: Don't feel guilty about taking a day off.
ex.zh: 請一天假不用覺得內疚。

ex.en: Will you tell me how to play the guitar?
ex.zh: 你可以教我彈吉他嗎？

ex.en: I want to learn how to play the guitar.
ex.zh: 我想學彈吉他。

ex.en: That guitar is so expensive that I can't buy it.
ex.zh: 那把吉他太貴了，我買不起。

guideline.zh: 指導方針、準則（常用複數）

ex.en: Please follow the safety guidelines.
ex.zh: 請遵守安全準則。

ex.en: The company issued new guidelines for remote work.
ex.zh: 公司發布了遠距工作的新規範。

ex.en: These guidelines will help you write a good report.
ex.zh: 這些準則能幫助你寫出好報告。

ex.en: He doesn't have the guts to say no to my plan.
ex.zh: 他沒膽拒絕我的計畫。

ex.en: You've got a lot of guts.
ex.zh: 你膽子真大。

ex.en: My gut tells me this deal is too good to be true.
ex.zh: 我的直覺告訴我這筆交易好得不像真的。

ex.en: I had a gut feeling that something was wrong.
ex.zh: 我直覺覺得有什麼不對勁。

ex.en: He has a big beer gut.
ex.zh: 他有個大啤酒肚。

ex.en: Yogurt is good for your gut health.
ex.zh: 優格對腸道健康有益。

ex.en: I regard myself as your guardian.
ex.zh: 我把自己當成你的監護人。

ex.en: A parent or legal guardian must sign the consent form.
ex.zh: 家長或法定監護人必須在同意書上簽名。

ex.en: She had a vague feeling of guilt.
ex.zh: 她隱約地有一種的內疚感。

ex.en: His sense of guilt was diminished.
ex.zh: 他的內疚感減少了。

ex.en: She was filled with guilt after lying to her friend.
ex.zh: 她對朋友說謊後充滿了罪惡感。

ex.en: I'm afraid he will never admit his guilt.
ex.zh: 恐怕他永遠也不會承認自己的罪行。

ex.en: He confessed his guilt.
ex.zh: 他承認他有罪。

ex.en: He admitted his guilt.
ex.zh: 他承認他有罪。

ex.en: He should apologize for being rude to the guests.
ex.zh: 他應該為自己對客人無禮而道歉。

ex.en: I'm back! Oh? Have we got a guest?
ex.zh: 我回來了！咦？有客人啊？

ex.en: The motel can accommodate as many as 400 guests.
ex.zh: 這家汽車旅館最多可以接待 400 位房客。

ex.en: I'll act as a guide for you.
ex.zh: 我來當你的導遊。

ex.en: They set out with a guide just in case they lost their way.
ex.zh: 他們請了一位嚮導同行，以免迷路。

ex.en: He acted as my guide.
ex.zh: 他擔任我的嚮導。

ex.en: This book is a good guide for beginners.
ex.zh: 這本書是很好的入門指南。

ex.en: Check the travel guide for good restaurants.
ex.zh: 查查旅遊指南，找家好餐廳。

ex.en: The staff will guide you to your seats.
ex.zh: 工作人員會帶你們到座位。

ex.en: She guided us through the old town.
ex.zh: 她帶我們逛了老城區。

ex.en: We joined a guided tour of the old city.
ex.zh: 我們參加了老城區的導覽行程。

ex.en: Guided tours are available in English and Japanese.
ex.zh: 導覽行程提供英語和日語。
